ops.value: A justification of a safety constant names one fact alone: source "library", reference the bare fact id exactly as library.facts lists it (for a speed, the id of the signed rule that bounds it, test.speedFloorPercent), with no document name, no "signed" note, no datasheet fact joined to it with a semicolon; a datasheet fact is not the reference of a safety constant, so leave it out of the reference.

reason: Both first submissions put several facts and prose in one reference for a step speed, which is not a fact id; the brief now says the reference is the single bare id of the bounding signed rule.
